title: Broken comment structure in a calculation
description:
Error-prone rule — a formula contains comment markers that cannot nest: a second /* inside an open comment, a stray */ after the block was already closed, or a // line comment glued to an opening /*. FileMaker comments do not nest, so parts of the formula end up inside or outside the comment against the author's intent.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Broken Calculation /*Commented Out*/" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: The parser resolves the markers differently than the layout of the text suggests. Code the author believes is live may sit inside a comment, or a fragment of a comment may end up being parsed as code — and the formula still saves.
rule.remediation: Rewrite the comments so every /* has exactly one matching */ and no comment opens inside another. Where a block needs to be switched off temporarily, comment it out in one piece.
